Scene:
一个人对神农说，麻烦我们可以吃什么植物？神农说，这就要看你想不想生病了。以后，神农告诉别人一些植物能吃，一些植物不能吃。

The teacher's corrections on this scene:
- 麻烦我们可以吃什么植物：麻烦告诉我们……
- 以后，神农告诉别人一些植物能吃，一些植物不能吃：后来，Time+以后；告诉人们，“别(的)” is for “a different type”, and “all else except the spoken one”；哪些，哪些

The system's item in each run:
Run 1: Coherence (Reference): 神农告诉：他告诉，because 神农 was the subject in the immediately preceding sentence and no competing character has appeared, a pronoun makes the close re-occurrence smoother. [rule: redundancy_delete]
Run 2: Coherence (Temporality): 告诉：告诉了，this later narrative event is presented as completed, so the verb needs 了; speaking verbs take the zero particle only when they directly introduce quoted speech. [rule: aspect_le_completed]
Run 3: (nothing flagged here)

output.reason: The runs target different issues (repetition versus aspect), and one run flags nothing.
